values.meaning: per-enemy-hit damage falloff multiplier and its floor
values.quote: {{pp|key=%|type=enemies hit|100*0.95^(x-1);50|x-1 for 15|formula=(100%-5%)^(1 per enemy hit). ''This is capped at 50% damage.''}}
values.binNote: 0.95 = 1-RDamageReductionPerHit(0.05) per additional enemy hit; 0.5 is the same RMinDamagePercent floor used for r_3, here confirmed as the multiplicative cap rather than an independent value.

mechanics.claim: Whirling Death can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling.
mechanics.quote: ''Whirling Death'' can be recast after 1 second while the axes are traveling

mechanics.claim: The axes automatically recast (reverse) upon hitting an enemy champion or reaching the edge of the map.
mechanics.quote: does so automatically after the axes hit an enemy {{tip|champion}} or the edge of the [[Map (League of Legends)|map]]

mechanics.claim: On the return pass the recast deals the same base damage/ratio formula as the outbound cast (subject to the same per-hit falloff, reset on reversal).
mechanics.quote: '''Draven''' forces the axes to reverse direction, slowly coming to a stop before homing back to him, dealing the same damage to enemies hit.

mechanics.claim: The per-enemy-hit damage falloff resets when the axes reverse direction (recast).
Each enemy can only be hit once per pass (outbound or return), i.e. a single target dummy takes at most one hit per pass.
mechanics.quote: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

mechanics.claim: Enemy champions damaged to or while below a health threshold equal to Draven's current League of Draven stacks are executed (killed outright).
mechanics.quote: Enemy {{tip|champions}} that are damaged to or while below a {{sti|{{as|health}}}} threshold equal to the number of ''{{ai|League of Draven|Draven|Adoration}}'' stacks are {{tip|execute|executed}}.

mechanics.claim: The cooldown begins when the ability is cast, not when the axes return.
A spell shield blocks only one instance of the damage (i.e. one pass, not both outbound and return).
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will block one instance of damage.
